go-cerebras 0.1.2 changelog:

- Added a license field (MIT) to SKILL.md for clearer licensing information.
- Expanded documentation to clarify how to discover endpoint methods and types using Go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Improved consistency in endpoint usage documentation, especially regarding streaming and error handling.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- No changes to functionality or user-facing documentation.

Initial release of go-cerebras: an unofficial, typed Go client for the Cerebras Inference API.

- Provides typed client methods for all 7 Cerebras API endpoints, including chat completions and model management.
- Supports API authentication via environment variable (CEREBRAS_API_KEY).
- Includes helpers for handling union schemas in requests and responses.
- Designed for use in Go projects that need to call Cerebras inference services.
- Not suitable for streaming usage; for streams, use the lower-level methods.
